spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Control Room Grid for dense areas.
spacing_and_layout.pos_terminal: flex h-screen overflow-hidden. Left Nav (w-20), Main Content (flex-1 flex flex-col p-6), Right Cart (w-[400px] border-l border-[#E5E0D8] bg-white p-6 flex flex-col).
spacing_and_layout.kitchen_display: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 items-start
spacing_and_layout.table_plan: relative w-full h-full bg-[#F0EBE1] rounded-3xl p-8 border border-[#E5E0D8]

surface_strategies.header: Solid background bg-white with a hard bottom border border-[#E5E0D8].
surface_strategies.menu_card: Flat background bg-white, 1px subtle border border-[#E5E0D8], rounded-2xl p-2. Image rounded-xl. Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg border-[#D4A373] transition-all duration-200.
surface_strategies.kitchen_ticket: bg-white border border-[#E5E0D8] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm. Header of ticket uses accent color for new orders.
surface_strategies.table_object: Rounded geometries (circles for round tables, rounded-2xl for square). bg-white border-2 border-[#E5E0D8]. Active table: border-[#2C4C3B] bg-[#2C4C3B]/5.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2C4C3B] text-white hover:bg-[#1A3025] hover:text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-4 font-bold transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F0EBE1] text-[#2C4C3B] hover:bg-[#E5E0D8] hover:text-[#1A3025] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-bold
buttons.accent: bg-[#D4A373] text-white hover:bg-[#C28E5B] hover:text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-bold
buttons.destructive: bg-[#9B4837] text-white hover:bg-[#7D382A] hover:text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-bold

components.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, rounded-xl border-[#E5E0D8] bg-[#F9F8F6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2C4C3B]/20 focus:border-[#2C4C3B] transition-all
components.dialog: Shadcn Dialog for Split Bill and Payment. Use rounded-3xl, p-8. No generic modal feel, make it feel like a tactile receipt.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for POS Categories. Use pill-style tabs: data-[state=active]:bg-[#2C4C3B] data-[state=active]:text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2 bg-transparent text-[#78716C] border border-[#E5E0D8]
components.charts: Recharts. Bar Chart for Top Items (using #2C4C3B and #D4A373). Heatmap for sales (custom grid of colored blocks).

icons_and_assets.installation: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react recharts clsx tailwind-merge framer-motion
icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone weight for primary navigation, Regular for dense UI actions.

animations_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have transform scaling (scale-95 for click, scale-105 for hover).
animations_and_motion.page_transitions: Framer motion for switching between POS, Kitchen, Tables, and Reports. Use opacity and subtle y-axis sliding.
animations_and_motion.cart_items: Animate layout shifts when items are added/removed from cart using framer-motion <motion.li layout />.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Primary button text (#FFFFFF) on #2C4C3B meets standard.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-menu-item', data-testid='cart-pay-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a responsive multi-view dashboard: 1. POS Terminal (Menu & Cart) 2. Table Floor Plan 3. Kitchen Display 4. Reports.
Use a Left Sidebar (w-20 or w-24) for main navigation between these views. It should just have icons and active state indicators.

The POS Terminal view: Split into Left/Center (Menu Grid) and Right (Order Cart Sidebar). The cart MUST include Modifiers, Order Notes, Discount/Promo inputs, Void/Refund buttons, and a massive 'PAY' CTA.
The Table Floor Plan: Create a visual map of tables using absolute positioning or CSS Grid, where tables change color if occupied (#2C4C3B/10 background, #2C4C3B border).
Kitchen Display: A horizontal timeline or bento grid of active order tickets. Tickets must show items, modifiers, and time elapsed.
Reports View: Incorporate Recharts to show a Sales Heatmap and a Top Items Bar Chart.
Payment Dialog: Implement a Shadcn Dialog for the payment step that includes a Split Bill functionality and Receipt Preview.
Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text. Enforce the Organic & Earthy palette strictly. Do not use generic Inter or generic blue/gray.
Cards should use the 1px subtle border rule, no heavy shadows until hovered.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' in index.css using @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');
